map.：某轮航速 12 节、航行 10 小时。航程 = 12 × 10 = 120 海: : A ship steams at 12 knots for 10 hours, so the distance = 12 × 10 = 120 nautical miles = 120×1.852 ≈ 222.24 km (≈222240 m); the speed converts as 12 kn ≈ 22.224 km/h ≈ 6.17 m/s. If the port 300 nautical miles away must be reached within 24 hours, the required speed = 300 ÷ 24 ≈ 12.5 knots.
